extraction_notes: Method: pdftotext -layout for tables; figures rasterized at 400 dpi and digitized by pixel analysis with gridline-derived axis calibration (linear axes from major gridlines, log axes from decade and minor gridline spacing).

Capacitance digitization independently validated: Figure 6 traces read 554/56.9/36.0 pF at VDS magnitude 15 V versus the table's 553/57/35 pF typicals, confirming axis calibration to within about 3 percent.
Rdson digitization consistency check: Figure 3 VGS = 10 V trace reads 48 mOhm near 4 A, matching the table typical 48 mOhm at VGS = -10 V, ID = -4 A.

The 25 degC transfer trace was identified positively: the TJ = 25 degC label leader line terminates on the middle of the three traces (125 degC leftmost, -55 degC rightmost). The same temperature ordering was applied to the body diode figure.

P-channel sign convention: table quantities are recorded with the datasheet's printed negative signs; figure axes are printed as magnitude axes (-VGS, -VDS, -ID, -IS, -VSD) and curve points are recorded as the positive magnitudes plotted on those axes.
All numeric quantities are SI: capacitances in farads (table pF and figure pF axis converted), resistances in ohms (figure mOhm axis converted), voltages in volts, currents in amperes.

Additional table facts not covered by schema fields: IDSS max 1 uA at VDS = -30 V; IGSS max +/-100 nA at VGS = +/-12 V; Qg typ 6.5 nC, Qgs typ 1.4 nC, Qgd typ 1.7 nC at VGS = 0 to -4.5 V, VDS = -15 V, ID = -3 A; td(on) 10 ns, tr 86 ns, td(off) 150 ns, tf 357 ns at VGS = -4.5 V, VDD = -15 V, ID = -3 A, RGEN = 3 Ohm; trr typ 36 ns and Qrr typ 5 nC at IF = -3 A, di/dt = 80 A/us; IS max -4 A, ISM max -16 A; ID -4 A at TA = 25 degC, -3 A at TA = 100 degC; IDM -16 A; PD 1.2 W at TA = 25 degC; RthJA 108 degC/W (1 in^2 2 oz copper FR4); no RthJC published; TJ/TSTG -55 to 150 degC; VGS max +/-12 V.
Figure 5 (gate charge, VDD = -15 V, ID = -3 A) exists but was not digitized; the tabulated Qg/Qgs/Qgd values above cover the gate-charge verification target.

Datasheet quirks: the page header mixes boilerplate strings ('P-Ch 30V', '20V Fast Switching MOSFETs', 'N-Ch', '20N02') from an apparent template; the electrical tables and figures are consistently the P-channel -30 V part 3401. Printed pages 05-06 contain an empty 'N-Channel typical performance' template heading with only the test circuit and SOT-23 package drawing.
No vendor SPICE models or model packs were used; every value above comes from the public datasheet PDF.
